code.name: National Structural Code of the Philippines (Vol.1) + NDRRMC shelter guidance
code.thermal_min_note: Natural ventilation priority in tropical climate
code.notes: Typhoon design class: super typhoon gust region; elevation vs storm surge governs siting.

structural_system: confined-masonry or RC frame, ductile detailing

strategies.sanitation: ventilated improved pit (VIP) or composting toilet; never discharge into flood zone

recommendations.measure: Use ductile moment-resisting frame or confined masonry with seismic ties
recommendations.reason: Earthquake susceptibility 0.33; code 'ph-nscc' requires design PGA >= 0.30 g (NSCP 2015, DPWH House Construction Manual (typhoon-resilient))

recommendations.measure: Raise finished floor >= 0.5 m above modelled design flood level, or select alternate parcel
recommendations.reason: Flood susceptibility 0.65; code expects protection for a 25-year return period event

recommendations.measure: Cool-roof (SRI>=78), external shading, night-purge ventilation; target indoor <=35C during heat alert
recommendations.reason: Heatwave susceptibility 0.57. Aligns with WHO shelter guidance and EPBD-style nearly-zero-energy intent where applicable

recommendations.measure: ventilated improved pit (VIP) or composting toilet; never discharge into flood zone
recommendations.reason: Sphere Standards WASH minimum requirements (20 L/person/day, 4.6 m2 shelter/person); flood/drought aware placement

recommendations.measure: Roof-mounted PV >= 200 W/person-served-day with battery; supports cooling and comms
recommendations.reason: High irradiance at this latitude; Sphere + IASC mental-health guidance on lighting and charging facilities

recommendations.measure: Provide at least one step-free, lockable, internally-connecting family unit
recommendations.reason: Sphere Standard 2 (Inclusive design) — recommended even where not codified

compliance_checks.detail: modelled demand ~0.16 g vs required >= 0.30 g

compliance_checks.check: floor elevation above water proximity threshold
compliance_checks.detail: elevation 0.0 m, distance to water 5000.0 m

compliance_checks.check: soil bearing adequate for chosen system
